commentary: Today, The DCE iron ore futures opened lower and then rebounded slightly. The most-traded contract I2509 ﬁnally closed at 689, with a daily decline of 2.68%. Traders showed poor willingness to sell at low prices; steel mills cauƟously waited and watched, with weak inquiries; market trading volume signiﬁcantly decreased compared to the previous two days. In Shandong, the mainstream transacƟon price of PB ﬁnes was around 741 yuan/mt, down 4 yuan/mt from yesterday; in Tangshan, the transacƟon price of PB ﬁnes was near 750-755 yuan/mt, down 0-5 yuan/mt from yesterday. According to the SMM survey, on April 9, the blast furnace operaƟng rate of 242 steel mills surveyed by SMM was 87.58%, up 0.09 percentage points MoM. The daily average pig iron producƟon of high-sample steel mills was 2.4204 million mt, up 7,300 mt MoM. The slight increase in pig iron producƟon provided limited support.
